classification.difficultyReason: Reverse ordered vertical translations, dilations and reflections to recover an unspecified original function.

content.prompt: For each of the following, describe a sequence of transformations that would restore it to $y=f(x)$.

answer.short: Translate down 1 unit, then dilate vertically by a factor of $\frac12$.
answer.worked:
Translate down 1 unit by replacing $y$ with $y+1$.
$$\begin{align*}y+1&=2f(x)+1\\y&=2f(x)\end{align*}$$
Dilate vertically by a factor of $\frac12$ by replacing $y$ with $2y$.
$$\begin{align*}2y&=2f(x)\\y&=f(x)\end{align*}$$

answer.short: Translate down 3 units, dilate vertically by a factor of $\frac12$, then reflect in the $x$-axis.
answer.worked:
Translate down 3 units by replacing $y$ with $y+3$.
$$\begin{align*}y+3&=3-2f(x)\\y&=-2f(x)\end{align*}$$
Dilate vertically by a factor of $\frac12$ by replacing $y$ with $2y$.
$$\begin{align*}2y&=-2f(x)\\y&=-f(x)\end{align*}$$
Reflect in the $x$-axis by replacing $y$ with $-y$.
$$\begin{align*}-y&=-f(x)\\y&=f(x)\end{align*}$$

answer.short: Dilate vertically by a factor of 3, then translate up 2 units.
answer.worked:
Dilate vertically by a factor of 3 by replacing $y$ with $\frac y3$.
$$\begin{align*}\frac y3&=\frac{f(x)-2}{3}\\y&=f(x)-2\end{align*}$$
Translate up 2 units by replacing $y$ with $y-2$.
$$\begin{align*}y-2&=f(x)-2\\y&=f(x)\end{align*}$$

answer.short: Translate down 2 units, dilate vertically by a factor of $\frac23$, then reflect in the $x$-axis.
answer.worked:
Translate down 2 units by replacing $y$ with $y+2$.
$$\begin{align*}y+2&=\frac{4-3f(x)}2\\y&=-\frac32f(x)\end{align*}$$
Dilate vertically by a factor of $\frac23$ by replacing $y$ with $\frac32y$.
$$\begin{align*}\frac32y&=-\frac32f(x)\\y&=-f(x)\end{align*}$$
Reflect in the $x$-axis by replacing $y$ with $-y$.
$$\begin{align*}-y&=-f(x)\\y&=f(x)\end{align*}$$
